svg.desc: 371 real consecutive dates, 2025-11-09 to 2026-11-14, woven into seven weekday strands. Each faceted cell represents one actual day. Logarithmic height and light encode its count. Only decorative energy travels; cells and counts never change. Activity is not a skill score.
